content: Developer Hub » Robots File Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000075850 To edit the default version of the Robots.txt file navigate to Developer Hub >> Robots File : Default Rules The default file includes the following rules. User-agent: Googlebot Disallow: /api/ Allow: / User-agent: Mediapartners-Google Disallow: /api/ Allow: / User-agent: Googlebot-Image Disallow: /api/ Allow: / User-agent: Yahoo-MMCrawler Disallow: /api/ Allow: / User-agent: Yahoo-slurp Disallow: /api/ Allow: / User-agent: slurp Disallow: /api/ Allow: / User-agent: Msnbot Disallow: /api/ Allow: / User-agent: MSNBot-media Disallow: /api/ Allow: / User-agent: Bingbot Disallow: /api/ Allow: / User-agent: Bing Preview bot Disallow: /api/ Allow: / User-agent: Twitterbot Disallow: /api/ Allow: / User-agent: * Disallow: / To add to the file, click inside the text field and add the necessary rules. Restore Default File The following button replaces any value imputed to the default version of the file: For additional assistance: Email support@brilliantdirectories.com or create a ticket Inside Your Account Dashboard .
